courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 混凝土面板堆石壩施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「分區滲透功能」與「排水帶流量與水頭」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；混凝土面板堆石壩施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Hydraulic functions of zones" and "Drain flow and hydraulic head" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Concrete-face rockfill dam construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦心牆阻水、反濾排水與分區填築的相容；混凝土面板堆石壩施工則以堆石變形、混凝土面板與周邊接縫的相容為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on compatibility of core sealing, filter drainage and zoned embankment placement; Concrete-face rockfill dam construction centres on compatibility of rockfill deformation, concrete facing and perimeter joints, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「分區滲透功能」與「堆石孔隙與密實」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到混凝土面板堆石壩施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「斜面水壓與合力」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Hydraulic functions of zones” and “Rockfill voids and density”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Concrete-face rockfill dam construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Hydrostatic resultant on an inclined face", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 心牆土石壩分區填築
history.titleEn: Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams
history.text: 心牆土石壩依靠分區材料共同工作，防滲不等於各區都阻水；反濾保持、排水連通和心牆應力狀態共同決定缺陷是否會擴大。反濾層標準章節更新，聚焦顆粒保持與區域界面。 土石壩設計與施工章節更新，連結材料、填築與品質控制。 滲流與監測章節更新，提供服役水壓及行為判讀背景。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。
history.textEn: Earth-core rockfill dams depend on coordinated zones rather than making every material impermeable. Filter retention, connected drainage and core stress together determine whether defects can progress. The protective-filter standard is updated, emphasizing particle retention and zone interfaces. Embankment design and construction chapters are updated to connect materials, placement and quality control. Seepage and monitoring chapters are updated, supporting interpretation of service pressures and behavior. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.
